name: cloudflare
description: Operate the entire Cloudflare platform — DNS, Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Stream, Images, Access, WAF, Load Balancers, and the GraphQL Analytics API — through the official remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Operate the Cloudflare platform through the official remote MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage your entire Cloudflare account — update DNS records, deploy Workers, upload files to R2, query your D1 database, configure WAF rules, purge the cache, and check analytics. From managing domains to deploying serverless functions, everything happens through natural language. No more jumping between the Cloudflare dashboard tabs: just tell your agent what needs to change, and it handles the rest.
defaultPrompt: Check my DNS records and tell me if everything looks correct.
Help me deploy a update to my Cloudflare Worker.
Show me the analytics for my site — traffic, cache hits, and security events.
